name: Sana-chan no Himitsu Kichi
original_name: さなちゃんのひみつきち
source:
Latchkey girl Sana has a secret base... a little shack in the woods behind the mountain.
She goes there to play. Her playtime is adult.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120628.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
挂钥匙女孩萨娜有一个秘密基地……山后树林里的一个小棚屋。
她去那里玩。她的游戏时间是成人的。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120628.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
